## Overview

Generic 5e travel pace and time rules apply by default. Settings with bubble / loop / dead-zone / region-specific encounter policies layer those on top via the game override.

---

## Pace and Time

Use 5e RAW for travel time and pace (PHB Travel rules). Fast / normal / slow paces and associated visibility / passive Perception adjustments apply as written.

---

## Random Encounters

**Default: no random encounters generated by this rules file.** Encounter generation is a setting-level choice, not a 5e mechanic this engine prescribes.

If the consuming game wants random encounters on travel, it supplies the framework in its override (encounter tables, frequency, region rules, exceptions for safe areas, etc.). If the game's override is silent on encounters, travel between locations is uneventful in the encounter sense unless the DM has seeded something specific for that route.

---

## Travel-Bound Setting Effects

Some settings have mechanics that fire during or around travel — region-edge phenomena, time-of-day triggers, weather, magical zones, etc. These are setting-specific and live in the game override or its dedicated rules files. This engine file does not enumerate them.
